column1: # Deliberate pre-6.0.0 spellings on the current documentation surface.
# NOT "findings we tolerate". Each line names an old identifier a page mentions
# ON PURPOSE, because the sentence is about the old name. Sweeping it would make
# the sentence false -- worse than the stale name it fixes.
# 🔴 AN ENTRY IS A CLAIM ABOUT ONE SENTENCE, NOT ABOUT A FILE. That is why the
#    third column exists: the token is spared only on lines containing that
#    anchor text. Measured reason -- transfer-admin-panels.md talks about the
#    legacy `mhm_` table prefix on line 103 and carries a genuinely stale
#    `admin_post_mhm_save_route` on line 95. A (file, token) allowlist would have
#    hidden the second while sparing the first.
# 🔴 FAILS TOWARD FLAGGING. Rewrite the sentence and the anchor stops matching,
#    so the name is swept and flagged again -- the safe direction. An entry that
#    no longer matches anything is dead and should be deleted; the probe prints
#    the skip count on every run so this file cannot quietly become a blindfold.
# Format:  <path><TAB><token><TAB><anchor text on the line><TAB><why>
